description: World-first Genesis: two distant god origins among three pre-existing, unaffiliated native villages; neither deity initially owns the entire land.
name: 暮影信仰

semantics.genesis: Player and AI start on separate sides of the map as real existing families (four each, no extra god-owned population); three pre-existing neutral villages hold nine native families total (27 unaffiliated residents).
semantics.nativeCommunities: Native homes and existing cultivated fields are pre-game world resources, not divine powers, and their residents have religionId=null, devotion=10. They autonomously work, build, pray only after adopting a faith, and can become new believers naturally.
semantics.settlements: Native villages exist from day 0 with independent membership, food reserves and construction rules. Each God's families can establish their own town through real house completion, not forced incorporation into nearby natives.
semantics.competition: Neither side begins in the other's household or town. Expansion into native communities happens through in-world sermons, exchange, Oracle propagation and later demographic movements; no instant mass conversions.
semantics.ai: Tiered decision quality, not only frequency: relaxed God attends one locally heard petition or a recurring personal ritual, uses coarsely sampled farmland and evaluates at most one Miracle. Standard God chooses from up to two plausible locally ranked choices based on nearby welfare, crops, petitions and seasonal agendas; does not scan every available spell. Original AI mode preserves the exact historical hard-coded local priority sequence. None has a global optimal map planner. All share the same real World rules, DP, cooldown and religious conversion.
semantics.legacy: Existing opponent-v0.1 saves retain their historical mixed-family positions. A no-opponent new browser world still has native populations; legacy saves remain unchanged.

difficultyNotes.relaxed: 休閒沙盒對手：以附近真實祈禱或自己的例行儀式作為決策主題；只檢查一個可能的神蹟，不會逐一嘗試所有合法神蹟；僅觀察周圍少數農田樣本。約每 24 天行動，沒有免費神力及作弊知識。
difficultyNotes.standard: 具備有限地區判斷：觀察周圍較多農田及信徒需求，依大致優先度和季節偏好只檢查兩項可行方案；神諭也會在民生與傳教目標間選擇。約每 18 天行動，不保證最優，但有其合理策略。
difficultyNotes.challenging: 原版 AI：維持舊有確定的候選順序和當地真實資訊檢查，沒有新增最佳化或更強的搜尋能力。最高難度只保留原本 AI 而不額外強化。
difficultyNotes.live: 難度切換會保留人口、農地、信仰、物資、存檔及現有 Miracle 冷卻；舊存檔沒有 difficulty 欄位者會回復到原版 AI，不會悄悄變弱。
